#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link is constructed using a base URL set by the environment variable `PUBLIC_URL`. If `PUBLIC_URL` is not defined, it defaults to `http://localhost:3000`. This default causes the links in the reset password emails to point to localhost when the environment variable is missing or not set correctly in the production or staging environment.

To fix this, ensure that the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable is properly set to the public-facing URL of the deployed application. This setting is expected to be configured outside of the source code, for example as an environment variable in hosting or deployment configuration. The code fallback to localhost is useful for local development but not for production.

No code change is necessary unless you want to add a validation or warning if `PUBLIC_URL` is missing in production environments.
